title: Hệ thống Thương mại điện tử

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the process of developing e-commerce systems, implement systems for businesses, and ensure security and safety in e-commerce activities.
Master web development technologies and techniques, apply software development principles to e-commerce systems.
Use IT tools to ensure security and safety in e-commerce activities.
Work independently or collaboratively, organize group activities, and demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics.
Understand and apply legal frameworks related to e-commerce.
Apply marketing principles in e-commerce contexts.
Identify and mitigate risks in e-commerce activities.
Solve problems related to e-commerce systems and operations.
Think critically about e-commerce systems and operations.
